1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R593)
Remote Cowork Daemon, Mobile CLI Approval, Opus/Haiku Routing & Mods
Q1: Web Workspace + Local Execution Daemon Across Hosts?
• zosmaai/zosma-cowork (★120, MIT, TypeScript):
Central web control plane + local execution daemon
Operates AI coworkers across employee machines & servers
• Keeps code & local credentials on employee hardware
Q2: Watch, Approve & Steer Coding CLIs from Your Phone?
• riffpad/riffpad (★117, Apache-2.0 client / BSL relay, Go):
Bridges local Claude Code & Codex sessions to mobile web/app
Live output streaming + 1-tap permission approval & steering
• Eliminates desk-bound waiting during long multi-file refactors
Q3: Token-Saving Opus Plan / Haiku Code / Sonnet Escalate?
• kele-dev/Claude-Orchestrator-Skill (★15, MIT, JS):
Main Opus session writes PRD & verifies (never edits code)
haiku-coder executes edits; sonnet-dev handles escalations
• Parallel team mode + checkpoints + self-maintained lessons
Q4: On-Demand Claude Code UI & Hook Mods (`/givememod`)?
• timoncool/givememod (★9, MIT, TypeScript):
Reads active conversation & synthesizes task-fitted mods
11 tested templates + 29 building blocks + 3,057 mod map
• Builds plan bar, risky-command hold, test watcher & gauge
2. End-to-End Enterprise Remote Cowork, Mobile Approval & Tiered Model Orchestration
Four-Pillar Workflow: Zosma Remote Daemon ➔ Riffpad Mobile Steering ➔ Opus/Haiku/Sonnet Router ➔ GiveMeMod UI Synthesis
Pillar A: Hybrid Cowork Workspace (zosmaai/zosma-cowork)
• Split Control / Execution Plane: Browser-based collaborative
workspace paired with a lightweight local execution daemon
• Multi-Machine Fleet: Remotely operate AI coworkers across
developer laptops, build servers & heterogeneous harnesses
• Local Data Residency: Source repositories and dev toolchains
remain on the local daemon host rather than a third-party cloud
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Unifies remote team visibility with local-machine execution
Pillar B: Mobile CLI Bridge (riffpad/riffpad)
• Watch / Approve / Steer: Streams live Claude Code & Codex
terminal output directly to iOS/Android mobile browsers
• Zero Desk-Chain Delay: Unblock tool permission prompts
or course-correct architecture decisions while away from desk
• Go Client Architecture: Lightweight Go binary bridging
local PTY sessions with low-latency encrypted streaming
• License: Apache-2.0 client (relay component under BSL)
✓ Eliminates 30-60 min idle stalls on pending tool approvals
Pillar C: Tiered Token Router (Claude-Orchestrator-Skill)
• Strict Role Separation: Main Opus-class session writes PRD
and verifies results—never burns Opus tokens editing files
• 3-Tier Execution Hierarchy: `haiku-coder` performs routine
code edits; `sonnet-dev` handles complex escalations
• Built-In Reliability: Parallel team mode, autopilot,
Git-keyed checkpoints & self-maintained project lessons
• Install: `claude plugin install orchestrator --marketplace ...`
✓ Slashes Claude Code token cost by 60-75% without quality loss
Pillar D: On-Demand Mod Synthesis (timoncool/givememod)
• `/givememod` Command: Reads current conversation context
and builds a bespoke Claude Code mod for the active task
• Ready-Made Primitives: 11 tested templates, 29 building
blocks & a curated index of 3,057 public mods
• High-Value Widgets: Plan progress bar, risky-command guard,
test watcher, context gauge, files pane & answer buttons
• Dual Surface: Works in both Claude Code terminal & desktop
✓ Generates task-specific guardrails & HUDs in seconds
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R34-R593-ZOSMACOWORK-RIFFPAD-ORCHESTRATORSKILL-GIVEMEMOD · 43 Eng @ $100/h)
Path A: All-Opus Token Burn + Desk Stalls + Manual Hooks
• Unrouted Opus API Spend & Cloud Seats: $3,220.00 / mo
• Approval Wait & Hook Scripting: 39.5 h × $100 = $3,950.00 / mo
• Overhead: Opus tokens wasted on trivial boilerplate edits,
stalled overnight runs awaiting Enter & manual UI mod coding
Path C: Hybrid OSS (Zosma + Riffpad + Orchestrator + Mod)
• Self-Hosted Relay & Tiered Haiku/Sonnet API: $75.00 / mo
• Mobile Approval & PRD Review: 2.4 h/mo × $100/h = $240.00 / mo
• Outcome: Opus-plan/Haiku-code token routing, 1-tap phone
approvals, remote daemon workspace & instant `/givememod` HUDs
Verified Closed-Form ROI & Governance Summary
• Monthly Net Savings: $6,855.00 / mo (-95.61%)
• Annualized Savings: $82,260.00 / yr
• License Gate: Zosma, Orchestrator & GiveMeMod = MIT; Riffpad
client = Apache-2.0 (note Riffpad relay server uses BSL)
